user.title: Choose the brand
user.description: Brand of the device you want to add. It is usually on the label or on the front.

model.title: Which {brand} model?
model.description: Look for the model on the device label. If you have several, add one and repeat.

connection.title: Connect to the device
connection.description: {brand} {model}. The connection is tested before continuing ({timeout} s at most).

data_description.host: It is in the communications menu of the device or in the device list of your router.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Change these only if you changed them on the device.

metering.title: How is the grid measured?
metering.description: {model}. Choose where the loads of the house are connected. This decides which meter measures the grid exchange and which device holds the grid power and energy.

data_description.metering: Loads on Grid: external meter at the connection point. Loads on Critical Loads: every load on the backup output; the internal meter measures the grid. Off-grid: no grid; the grid terminals may feed a generator.

components.title: What does your installation have?
components.description: {model}. {main} is always added. Select the other parts of your installation: each one shows up in Home Assistant as its own device. You can change this later in «Reconfigure».

readings.title: Device found
readings.description:
✓ Responding at {host}. Check that these values match the device display:

{readings}

data_description.name: This is the name of the group of devices in Home Assistant. You can change it later.
data_description.device_id: Internal ID of the integration. It distinguishes devices of the same type. It has nothing to do with the Modbus Unit ID.

reconfigure.title: Change the connection
reconfigure.description: {brand} {model}. The connection is tested before continuing ({timeout} s at most).

data_description.device_id: Internal ID of the integration. It distinguishes devices of the same type. It has nothing to do with the Modbus Unit ID.

advanced.name: Advanced options
advanced.description: Change these only if you changed them on the device.

reconfigure_components.title: What does your installation have?
reconfigure_components.description: {model}. {main} is always added. What you untick is removed from Home Assistant with its history.

reconfigure_rename.title: Rename entities

error.cannot_connect: No response from {host}:{port} after {timeout} s. Check the IP, enable Modbus TCP on the device and close other Modbus clients, such as the EMS.
error.endpoint_in_use: Another device already uses this IP and port with a different configuration.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected response from {host}:{port}. The model or the Unit ID may not be the right ones.
error.interval_too_short: Too short for this device: reading all its registers takes longer.
error.device_id_in_use: There is already a {device_type} with ID {device_id}.
error.invalid_serial_number: Use only letters and numbers, with no spaces.
error.interval_budget_exceeded: These intervals request {rate} reads per second, but the device allows 1. Raise one of them.
error.metering_component_required: {component} is needed for «{mode}». Tick it or change the grid metering.

bms_forced_charge_soc.name: Forced charge due to low SOC

write_failed.message: Could not write to the device: {error}

options.ingeteam_oneplay_storage: STORAGE 1Play TL M — hybrid inverter with battery

options.pv: Solar array — PV1, PV2 and external PV
options.battery: Battery — charge, health, limit reasons and BMS alarms
options.grid: Grid (external meter) — voltage, frequency, power and grid energies

options.read: Leave it empty: this model sends it over Modbus. Read: {serial}.
options.unreadable: This model sends it over Modbus, but it could not be read. Copy it from the label.
options.none: This model does not send it over Modbus. Copy it from the label of the device.
options.reconfigure: Leave it empty to read it over Modbus.
